{{Top|leg}}
A '''proton warhead''' was a model of explosive [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]]. Miniature proton warheads were installed in [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries']] [[3t3 missile]], and were powerful enough to destroy a combat [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], and inflict significant damage on [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] with a precise enough shot.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
